overview_description.description: Watermelon Ecosystem is a UAE-based food and beverage procurement and business management platform that connects restaurants, hotels, caterers, and suppliers through a digital marketplace. The company provides tools for supplier sourcing, order and invoice management, cloud-based POS systems, financing support, analytics, and marketing services tailored to the HORECA industry. Its platform is designed to streamline procurement workflows, improve supply chain coordination, and support local sourcing initiatives within the F&B sector.

about_short_description.short_description: Watermelon Market is a SaaS company that supplies an ordering platform created for food and beverage buyers and sellers.

product.name: Watermelon Market Platform
product.description: A SaaS ordering platform connecting food and beverage buyers with suppliers for streamlined procurement and supply management.

product.name: Watermelon Finance
product.description: Financial solutions tailored for the F&B industry, offering flexible funding options like buy now pay later and working capital support.

product.name: Cloud POS System
product.description: A cloud-based point-of-sale system enabling remote access and management of restaurant sales and inventory.

product.name: Supplier Listing and Tender Participation
product.description: A service allowing suppliers to list products for free, automate purchase orders and invoices, and join large-scale tenders to connect with buyers.

product.name: Local Sourcing Network
product.description: A network connecting F&B businesses with local farmers and manufacturers to source fresh, locally-produced food and beverage products.

product.name: Marketing Services
product.description: Services supporting F&B businesses with branding and digital marketing needs.
